verdict.rationale: Fin ships a CLI built for AI coding agents, so a user can set up Fin and configure the Intercom helpdesk by instructing their coding agent in natural language. An official MCP server also lets AI tools work with Intercom data. However, the natural-language layer comes from the user's external agent rather than a native command interface inside Fin, and features like 'Giving Fin Guidance' appear only as bare titles. Missing for 10: a documented native natural-language command or console interface for operating and administering Fin, details on what the CLI and MCP can do beyond setup and data access, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Point your AI coding Agent at the Fin CLI to set up Fin on your website and configure your Intercom helpdesk — all without leaving your coding environment.
MCP is a protocol that enables AI tools and applications to securely access and interact with your Intercom data whenever helpful.
